title: prox ssh: handle N/A IP sentinel with helpful message
description: Review P0 #6. GetVMIP/GetContainerIP return "N/A" not "", so cmd/ssh.go:139 never fires and users see invalid IP address: N/A. Check for N/A now; longer term return an error from the client (see client refactor). Risk: safe.

title: ct create --node is silently overridden by template node
description: Review P0 #7. pkg/container/create.go:29-40 switches to the first node holding the template even when user passed --node; with shared template storage users can never pick a node. Collect all nodes holding the template; use requested node if present, else fail clearly.
close_reason: Requested --node is used when the template is available there (shared storage); otherwise existing fallback-with-warning kept for compatibility

title: prox status should honour PROX_* environment variables
description: Review P0 #5. cmd/status.go calls config.Check()/config.Read() directly, so env-only CI setups get no configuration found. Use client.ReadConfig() and drop the Check() gate. Risk: safe.

title: Wire up or deprecate ignored --node flag on vm start/shutdown/delete/edit/clone
description: Review P0 #4. --node is registered and documented on cmd/vm/{start,shutDown,delete,edit,clone}.go but never read. Pass it through to FindByNameOrID as a filter (fail clearly if no match), or MarkDeprecated/hidden. Do not remove the flag.
close_reason: --node now filters the name/ID lookup on vm start/shutdown/delete/edit/clone; migrate --source does too

title: Return non-zero exit codes when commands fail
description: Review P0 #3. Failures exit 0 in: pkg/vm/operations.go DeleteVM (no error return; DeleteVMByNameOrID always nil), pkg/vm/config.go EditVM, pkg/container/templates.go ListTemplates, and all cmd/config/* Run funcs. Also drop the Error: prefix for empty vm list. Return errors and exit 1 in cmd layer. Behaviour change (correct) - release-note it.
close_reason: Delete/edit/templates/vm test/config commands now return errors and exit 1; empty lists no longer prefixed Error:

title: Fix ct create --ssh-keys-file - (stdin) reading no keys
description: Review P0 #2. cmd/ct/create.go:129 uses fmt.Scanln(&line) which reads one whitespace token; for an SSH key it returns expected newline and the loop breaks, so no keys are read. Use io.ReadAll(os.Stdin) or bufio.Scanner; only print the Ctrl+D hint when stdin is a TTY. Risk: safe (feature currently broken).
close_reason: Fixed: template parsing handles <os>-<version>-<flavour> names with legacy fallback; stdin SSH keys read with bufio.Scanner. Tests added.

title: Fix ct template version parsing so debian:12 resolves
description: Review P0 #1. pkg/container/utils.go:47 parseTemplateVersion returns Unknown for debian-12-standard_12.7-1 and rockylinux-9-default volids, so the documented debian:12 shortcut fails. Parse <os>-<version>-<flavour>_... from the filename after vztmpl/. Also: parseTemplateDescription only strips .tar.gz (templates are .tar.zst/.tar.xz) and parseTemplateOS returns Unknown for rocky/alma/arch etc. Add table-driven tests with real volids. Risk: safe.
close_reason: Fixed: template parsing handles <os>-<version>-<flavour> names with legacy fallback; stdin SSH keys read with bufio.Scanner. Tests added.

title: Implement parallel IP lookups for VM listing
description: Sequential IP lookups in pkg/vm/list.go:65-74 cause N API calls taking ~100-500ms each. Implement goroutine worker pool (max 10 workers) for concurrent IP fetching. Expected 5-10x performance improvement for clusters with many VMs.

title: Add --json output format for all list commands
description: Add machine-readable JSON output option for scripting/automation. Implement --json flag for vm list, ct list, and other list commands. Output should be valid JSON array of objects.

title: Standardize error handling across codebase
description: Functions inconsistently use return vs os.Exit(1). Standardize on returning errors from domain functions (pkg/*) and let CLI layer (cmd/*) decide exit behavior. Makes code testable and library-friendly.

title: Performance Optimizations
description: Epic for tracking all performance optimization work. Includes parallel processing, caching strategies, connection pooling, and API call optimizations.

title: Fix smaller correctness issues from review (P1 #14)
description: Review P1 #14 list: GetID only checks qemu IDs (clone onto LXC ID); MigrateVM says now running for offline migrations; CPU percent computed two ways in vm/utils.go - extract vmFromResource helper; FindByNameOrID silently picks first of duplicate names (return ambiguous error); DeleteProfile leaves current-profile pointing at deleted profile; CreateProfile non-atomic/perm window/ignored write errors; validate profile names; config setup prints exists + completed; prompt for missing setup values on TTY; mask password in config read (--show-password); partial PROX_* env vars silently ignored; vm edit --disk help should say grow by N GB; mojibake chars in pkg/vm/config.go:108,142; .gitignore typo test/e2e -> tests/e2e/config.env.
notes: Also done: CreateProfile writes atomically with 0600 from the start; config setup no longer prints 'already exists' then 'completed successfully'.
close_reason: All items done across commits: ID check covers containers, migrate wording, vmFromResource, ambiguous names error, DeleteProfile pointer, atomic CreateProfile, profile name validation, setup messages + TTY prompts, config read masking, partial env warning, --disk help, mojibake, .gitignore.

title: Remove busy-loop client WaitForTask and dedupe waitForTask
description: Review P1 #13. pkg/client/helpers.go WaitForTask has select default with no sleep (hot loop); unused but exported on the interface. Delete or make it the single backoff implementation used by pkg/vm and pkg/container (identical copies today). Remove unused TaskPollIntervalSeconds.
close_reason: Client WaitForTask now uses shared PollTask with backoff; vm/container waitForTask use WaitForTaskSuccess; unused constant removed

title: prox ssh: safer SSH config editing
description: Review P1 #11. cmd/ssh.go: writes StrictHostKeyChecking no + UserKnownHostsFile /dev/null (make opt-in or use accept-new for new entries); add/remove skip until next Host line and delete following Match blocks/comments; non-atomic write, no backup, symlink-aware rename needed; IPv4-only validation (use net.ParseIP; extractIPFromInterfaces also IPv4-only); default User is the VM name (consider $USER or omit for new entries); list parser breaks on tab/= separated directives.
notes: Host key decision applied: new entries use OpenSSH defaults; --no-host-key-check restores old behaviour. Remaining: default User = VM name; extractIPFromInterfaces IPv4-only.
close_reason: Done: sshconfig package (Match/comments/globals preserved, insert after global section, atomic symlink-aware write + backup, Keyword=value parsing, IPv6 via net.ParseIP), OpenSSH host key defaults with --no-host-key-check opt-in, default User = local username. Not done: extractIPFromInterfaces still picks IPv4 only.

title: Stop fabricating disk usage numbers (incl. --json)
description: Review P1 #12. pkg/vm/list.go estimates Disk=MaxDisk/5 or /10 and uses MaxDisk=1 sentinel, leaking into JSON; client.go GetVMDiskInfo repeats the estimate; getVMDiskUsageFromRRD returns diskwrite*3600. Report unknown as N/A / null; use guest agent get-fsinfo for --detailed; remove RRD heuristic. JSON values change - release-note.
close_reason: Estimates, max_disk=1 sentinel and RRD heuristic removed. Unknown usage is 0 in JSON and N/A in table/describe; --detailed and describe use QEMU guest agent get-fsinfo for real usage.

title: Make TLS verification configurable (--insecure, --ca-cert, fingerprint)
description: Review P1 #10. client.go hardcodes InsecureSkipVerify. Add per-profile/env options. Keep insecure default for existing profiles (no setting = insecure); new profiles try verified first and fall back with a warning. Optional PROX_FINGERPRINT pinning. Additive.
close_reason: TLS verified by default (user decision). --insecure/--ca-cert global flags, PROX_INSECURE/PROX_CA_CERT, per-profile via config setup/create/update. Cert failures explain the fix. Fingerprint pinning not done.

title: Add Proxmox API token authentication
description: Review P1 #9. Help text says PROX_PASSWORD accepts an API token but only ticket auth exists. Add PROX_TOKEN_ID/PROX_TOKEN_SECRET (and --token-id/--token-secret on config setup/create); send Authorization: PVEAPIToken=user@realm!id=secret and skip ticket/CSRF. Fix help text until shipped. Additive.
notes: Help text no longer claims PROX_PASSWORD accepts an API token (done with prox-6r3.10).
close_reason: Token auth via token ID (user@realm!name) as username and secret as password; works in profiles and PROX_* env vars with no new config fields. Docs and help updated.

title: Harden credential decryption: explicit errors, fingerprint check, versioned prefix
description: Review P1 #8. pkg/crypto: key derived from hostname (changes on macOS); Decrypt returns garbage bytes when GCM fails instead of erroring; plaintext detection via isBase64 misfires on passwords like admin123/password (verified). Fixes: error on GCM failure with re-run setup tip; compare stored key fingerprint; write enc:v1: prefix for new values while reading old format. Later: OS keychain / per-install random key. Update docs/SECURITY.md to describe this as obfuscation at rest.
close_reason: Decrypt returns ErrWrongKey instead of garbage; short base64-looking plaintext treated as plaintext; fingerprint compared and reported with fix command; enc:v1: prefix accepted on read (not yet written, for downgrade safety); SECURITY.md describes threat model. Keychain/per-install key left for future.

title: Code review follow-ups (docs/CODE_REVIEW.md)
description: Track all fixes and improvements from the 2026-11-11 deep code review in docs/CODE_REVIEW.md. Constraint: prox is an OSS tool with active users, so no breaking changes to CLI flags, output, or config files; behaviour changes need release notes or opt-in flags. Suggested PR sequencing is in the review's final section.

title: Eliminate redundant 'Error: Error' messages
description: Fix redundant error message formatting across cmd/ directory. Currently many files use patterns like 'Error: Error starting container' which is unprofessional. Create output.UserError() function for consistent, non-redundant error messaging. Affects 40+ error messages in cmd/ files.

title: Standardize error handling in VM operations
description: Change void functions in pkg/vm/operations.go to return error instead of silently failing. Functions like ShutdownVMWithWait and StartVMWithWait should return error for proper error handling.

title: Parallelize container IP fetching in list operations
description: Apply the existing fetchIPsConcurrently worker pool pattern from vm/list.go to container/list.go. Currently container IPs are fetched sequentially while VMs use parallel workers. This provides 5-10x speedup for container lists.

title: Parallelize config and status fetching in describe operations
description: Parallelize GetVMConfig and GetVMStatus calls in vm/describe.go and container/describe.go using goroutines. Currently these are sequential API calls that could be done in parallel for ~50% latency reduction. Quick win with low effort.

title: Fix missing error handling in config.go
description: pkg/config/config.go:25-26 silently ignores error from os.UserHomeDir(). Add proper error handling or fallback.

title: Add shell completion support
description: Add tab completion for bash/zsh/fish/powershell. Cobra has built-in completion generation. Add completion command that generates shell-specific completion scripts.

title: Add --quiet/-q flag for scripting
description: Add quiet mode to suppress progress messages for scripting. With -q flag, only output errors (to stderr) and final results. No emoji, progress messages, or tips.
close_reason: Infrastructure complete: created pkg/output utility, added --quiet/-q flag to root command, demonstrated usage in GetID function. Remaining work (updating all pkg/ print statements) tracked in prox-vho.

title: Implement client caching to reduce API calls
description: CreateClient() is called in every domain function, creating new authenticated client each time. Add client caching per session and reuse option for batch operations. Should improve performance and reduce authentication overhead.

title: Remove emojis for professional CLI output
description: Heavy emoji usage makes output feel casual. Remove emojis from all standard output across codebase. Use color for status if terminal supports it. Update files: pkg/vm/operations.go, pkg/vm/list.go, pkg/container/*.go, cmd/ssh.go, cmd/config/*.go, pkg/node/*.go

title: Extract duplicate IP discovery logic
description: getVMIPFromGuestAgent and getContainerIPFromGuestAgent in pkg/client/client.go:711-794 and 900-983 have ~90% code duplication. Extract common IP extraction logic into shared helper function.

title: UX Improvements
description: Epic for tracking all user experience improvements. Includes new output formats, better error messages, shell completion, and professional CLI output.
close_reason: All 5 UX improvement tasks completed: eliminated redundant errors, added fuzzy matching for not found messages, implemented shell completion, standardized error context, and added progress spinners

title: Code Quality Improvements
description: Epic for tracking all code quality improvements identified in codebase analysis. Includes error handling standardization, code duplication removal, constants extraction, and other refactoring work.
close_reason: All code quality improvements completed: error handling standardization, magic number replacement, and utility function extraction

title: CI improvements: go-version-file, golangci-lint, govulncheck, -race, OS matrix
description: Review P3 #24. Workflow pins Go 1.21 while go.mod needs 1.23; use go-version-file: go.mod. Add golangci-lint (errcheck, govet, staticcheck, ineffassign, unused), govulncheck, go test -race, and build for each GOOS incl. Windows.
close_reason: CI uses go-version-file, adds golangci-lint v2.15.0 (.golangci.yml, 0 issues), govulncheck v1.9.0, go test -race, make build-all. Toolchain bumped to go1.27.4 (10 called stdlib vulns in go1.27.1/1.23 fixed).

title: Add unit test suite (pure funcs, ssh config golden files, crypto/config, httptest client)
description: Review P3 #23. Only one test file exists. Targets: parseTemplateVersion/OS, parseUPIDNode, parseDiskSize, ValidateDiskSize, extractIPFromInterfaces, hasTag, fuzzy, format; add/removeFromSSHConfig golden files (Match, comments, multi-host, Include); crypto round trip + legacy + wrong key; profile ops under t.TempDir with HOME override; httptest client fixtures.
close_reason: Unit tests now cover template parsing, SSH keys, sshconfig (golden-style), crypto, profiles/TLS, client (httptest: auth, tokens, TLS, retry, errors, polling, fsinfo, force stop, escaping), util, tags, UPID parsing. sshconfig 83%, util 95%, config 41%, client 28%.

title: ct create: --bridge/--ip/--vlan flags and smarter storage default
description: Review P2 #22. net0 hardcoded to vmbr0/dhcp; default storage local-lvm missing on ZFS installs. Add flags; if --storage not given and local-lvm absent, pick first rootdir-capable storage and say so. Additive.
close_reason: ct create --bridge/--ip/--gateway/--vlan (defaults give the old net0 exactly); storage default local-lvm if present else first active rootdir storage, falling back to local-lvm if the lookup fails.

title: Shell completion: profiles, nodes, positional-arg awareness
description: Review P2 #21. GetProfileNames is a stub - wire to config.ListProfiles for config use/delete and --profile; register GetNodeNames for --node/--source/migrate target; stop suggesting names for args after the first.
close_reason: Profile completion (config use, --profile); node completion for --node/--source/migrate target/node describe; name completion limited to first arg; clone gets VM completion.

title: Refactor Proxmox client: typed generic request helper, remove dead code, trim IP lookups
description: Review P2 #19. client.go repeats request/unmarshal/type-assert ~15 times; add doJSON[T]. Remove dead code: getVMIPFromClusterResources, getStorageVolumeSize, vm GetVM(), VirtualMachine.Config, pkg/conversion, unused constants. GetVMIP calls non-existent qemu /interfaces and looks for net key in status - keep guest agent + ipconfigN parsing. Return errors instead of N/A sentinel. Do behind httptest suite.
close_reason: requestData[T] replaces 14 copies of request/decode boilerplate (same results and messages); removed dead code (GetVM, VirtualMachine.Config/Status, FirstRun, pkg/conversion, getStorageVolumeSize, unused constants); VM IP lookup trimmed to guest agent + cloud-init ipconfigN (old status/interfaces lookups hit non-existent fields/endpoints). N/A sentinel kept deliberately.

title: HTTP client robustness: path escaping, 401 re-auth, auth mutex, error bodies
description: Review P2 #20. url.PathEscape interpolated segments; re-authenticate once on 401 (ticket expiry during logs --follow); guard Authenticate with mutex/once; truncate or parse PVE error bodies instead of dumping raw HTML.
close_reason: 401 -> one re-login and retry; ticket guarded by mutex; errors use Proxmox status reason + JSON message/errors, bodies truncated; node/upid/storage path segments escaped.

title: Consistent --wait/--no-wait/--timeout flags and Ctrl-C handling
description: Review P2 #17. Wait defaults differ across vm start/shutdown/clone/migrate/delete and ct ops. Keep defaults; add missing opt-in/opt-out flags everywhere, document defaults, add --timeout, use signal.NotifyContext at root and print UPID on interrupt. Additive.
close_reason: All task commands accept --wait/--no-wait (defaults unchanged, shown in help); global --timeout; Ctrl-C/timeout stop waiting with a prox logs --follow hint.

title: Add vm/ct stop --force (hard stop) and reboot/reset
description: Review P2 #18. vm stop is an alias for graceful shutdown; no /status/stop path. Add --force on shutdown/stop for vm and ct; consider vm reboot/reset. Additive.
close_reason: vm shutdown/stop --force and ct stop --force use /status/stop. reboot/reset not added (split to feature if wanted).

title: Route errors/progress/spinner to stderr, keep stdout for results
description: Review P2 #16. Many fmt.Printf("Error: ...") go to stdout; spinner writes to stdout; config.MigrateToProfiles prints to stdout inside Read() and can corrupt --json. Use pkg/output, spinner Writer=os.Stderr, skip spinner in quiet/non-TTY.
close_reason: Errors/warnings to stderr; shared output.StartSpinner writes to stderr and is skipped in quiet mode or when stderr isn't a terminal; profile migration notice to stderr.

title: Standardise commands on RunE with SilenceUsage/SilenceErrors
description: Review P2 #15. RunE errors (ssh, status) dump full usage text. Set RootCmd.SilenceUsage/SilenceErrors, print once in Execute via pkg/output, convert Run+os.Exit to RunE one command group per PR. Safe.
notes: User-visible part done: runtime errors no longer print usage (SilenceUsage in root PersistentPreRun), and all failing commands exit 1 (prox-6r3.3). Remaining is code style only: convert Run+os.Exit to RunE.

title: Remove all emojis from project including commands
description: Remove all emoji characters from the codebase including: output messages, command help text, status indicators, and any other user-facing strings. Replace with text-based alternatives where indicators are needed.
close_reason: Removed all emojis from project commands and output

title: Fix make fmt failing in pull request
Update README with session improvements
description: Document all completed work: Performance improvements (parallelization, caching), Code Quality improvements (constants, utilities, error handling), UX improvements (error messages, fuzzy matching, shell completion, progress spinners). Add usage examples and installation instructions.

title: Fix inconsistent error context
description: Create command-specific error handlers (output.VMError, output.ContainerError) and enforce consistent usage across all commands. Many commands use raw fmt.Printf() instead of the existing output.APIError() and other specialized handlers.

title: Standardize progress feedback
description: Implement consistent progress indicators for long-running operations. Use spinner library consistently across all wait operations. Add step counters for multi-step operations. Ensure all async operations provide visual feedback.

title: Enhance resource not found messages
description: When resources (VMs, containers, profiles) are not found, provide helpful suggestions including fuzzy matching for similar names and guidance to list available resources. Currently shows generic 'not found' without actionable help.

title: Add shell completion support
description: Add bash/zsh/fish shell completion support using Cobra's built-in completion command. Implement dynamic completers for resource names (VMs, containers, nodes, profiles). This improves productivity by allowing tab-completion of commands and resource identifiers.

title: Replace magic numbers with named constants
description: Replace magic number 1 used for Proxmox API boolean parameters with named constants like ProxmoxBoolTrue and ProxmoxBoolFalse in pkg/client/constants.go.

title: Extract duplicated utility functions to shared package
description: Move formatSize and formatUptime functions from pkg/vm/utils.go and pkg/container/utils.go to a shared pkg/util or pkg/formatting package to eliminate code duplication.

title: Implement storage volume lookup caching
description: Cache storage content queries in GetVMDiskInfo to avoid repeated API calls when VMs have multiple disks on the same storage. Provides 3-5x speedup for multi-disk VMs.

title: Add IP address caching for bulk operations
description: Implement short-lived IP address cache (30-60s) at client level to reduce redundant lookups during bulk operations. Affects all list/describe operations. 30-50% reduction in repeated lookups.

title: Complete quiet mode implementation across all commands
description: Infrastructure for --quiet/-q flag is complete (pkg/output, root command flag). Need to update remaining print statements across pkg/ to use output.Info(), output.Result(), output.Error() instead of fmt.Printf/Println. Files needing updates: pkg/vm/*.go, pkg/container/*.go, pkg/node/*.go, cmd/*.go

title: Add --json output format for describe commands
description: Implement --json flag for vm describe, ct describe, and node describe commands to support machine-readable output for automation.

title: Add prox config test command
description: Add config validation command that tests connection, authentication, API version, and node access. Provides clear pass/fail feedback.

title: Improve error messages with actionable advice
description: Technical error messages lack actionable advice. Add helpful suggestions for common errors (auth failures, connection issues). Include 'Run prox config setup' hints.

title: Add VM/CT name support for all commands
description: Some commands only accept VMID, not name. Ensure all commands (clone, migrate, etc) accept both name and ID consistently.

title: Add prox status command
description: Add command to check connection status and cluster health. Show connection URL, cluster name, node count, VM/CT counts with status breakdown.

title: Add prox vm/ct exec command
description: Add ability to execute commands inside VMs/containers directly: 'prox ct exec mycontainer -- ls -la'. Useful for quick operations without SSH.
close_reason: Not feasible: Proxmox VE API does not provide endpoints for executing commands inside LXC containers (pct exec is CLI-only). For VMs, qemu-guest-agent exec is available but requires guest agent installation and configuration changes (guest-exec must be removed from RPC blacklist). The practical solution for users is to use SSH, which prox already supports via the 'prox ssh' command. Feature cannot be implemented without significant complexity and external dependencies.

title: Add cluster resources caching
description: GetClusterResources() called frequently without caching. Add short-lived cache (5-10 seconds) to reduce redundant API calls.

title: Configure HTTP transport for connection pooling
description: pkg/client/client.go:94-114 uses default http.Client settings. Configure transport with MaxIdleConns, MaxIdleConnsPerHost, IdleConnTimeout for better connection reuse.

title: Add nil pointer checks for VMID
description: pkg/vm/list.go:38 potential nil pointer dereference if resource.VMID is nil. Add nil checks before dereferencing.

title: Fix redundant template API calls
description: pkg/container/templates.go:104-158 ResolveTemplate calls getClusterNodes and getNodeTemplates twice. Cache and reuse results.

title: Consolidate VM/CT lookup functions
description: cmd/ssh.go:191 duplicates lookup logic from domain packages. Move findVMByNameOrID and findContainerByNameOrID to pkg/vm and pkg/container for reuse.

title: Replace manual type assertions with struct unmarshaling
description: pkg/client/client.go:302-360 uses extensive manual type assertion. Use direct JSON unmarshaling into structs for cleaner, safer code.

title: Extract magic numbers into constants
description: Multiple magic numbers without constants across codebase. Create pkg/client/constants.go with HTTPTimeout, VMIDMin/Max, VMNameMaxLength, disk usage divisors, etc.

title: Replace boolean parameters with options struct
description: pkg/vm/list.go:89 ListVMs has multiple boolean parameters making calls confusing. Replace with ListOptions struct for clarity and extensibility.

title: Add --force flag and confirmation for destructive operations
description: Add confirmation prompts before deletion (vm delete, ct delete). Support --force flag to skip confirmation for automation. Prevents accidental deletions.

title: Optimize template search with index map
description: pkg/container/templates.go:170-182 uses linear search through all templates. Build index map for O(1) lookups by OS:version. Low effort, improves template resolution performance.

title: Credential storage: OS keychain and write enc:v1: prefix
description: Follow-up from prox-6r3.8. (1) Store credentials in the OS keychain (zalando/go-keyring) with the file scheme as fallback, or derive the key from a random per-install secret in ~/.prox/key so hostname changes stop breaking configs. (2) Start writing the enc:v1: prefix in Encrypt once enough releases can read it (read support shipped in 4fd7997), so plaintext vs ciphertext is unambiguous.

title: prox ssh --connect / --print
description: Review feature idea #6. Exec ssh directly or print the ssh command line without editing ~/.ssh/config. Additive.
close_reason: prox ssh --connect runs ssh directly; --print prints a shell-quoted ssh command (status to stderr). Neither touches ~/.ssh/config.

title: vm create from cloud-init template in one command
description: Review feature idea #5. Clone + set ipconfig0/sshkeys/ciuser + resize + start. Additive.
close_reason: prox vm create <name> --from <template>: clone + wait, cores/memory, ipconfig0 (dhcp or static+gw), ciuser, sshkeys (Proxmox URL encoding), disk grow, optional --start. Partial failure tells the user which VM to fix or delete.

title: Container parity with VMs: ct clone/migrate/edit/reboot
description: Review feature idea #4. Additive.
close_reason: ct clone/migrate (--restart for running)/edit (hostname, cores, memory, --disk grow)/reboot, plus vm reboot. All with wait flags and completion.

title: Snapshot commands for VMs and containers
description: Review feature idea #3. vm/ct snapshot create/list/rollback/delete. Additive.
close_reason: prox vm|ct snapshot list/create/rollback/delete (shared pkg/snapshot); --vmstate for VMs; confirmation on rollback/delete; wait flags; snapshot-name completion; JSON/YAML list.

title: Unified --output json|yaml|table|wide flag across commands
description: Review feature idea #2. Single persistent flag; keep existing --json as alias. ct describe, node list, status, config list, ct templates lack JSON today. Additive.
close_reason: Global -o/--output table|json|yaml; --json kept as alias; status, config list, ct templates gained structured output; Info messages suppressed in structured mode; empty lists print []. 'wide' not implemented.

title: Release/distribution: Docker version ldflags, pinned base, checksums/GoReleaser
description: Review P3 #25. Dockerfile build lacks -X main.version so container prints dev; pin alpine or use distroless static nonroot; add checksums/signing (GoReleaser + cosign, Homebrew tap, deb/rpm); drop the GHCR :init namespace step.
notes: Done: Docker builder golang:1.27.4-alpine3.24 (was 1.23 with GOTOOLCHAIN=local, so images missed the patched toolchain), runtime alpine:3.24, version/commit/date ldflags via build args, sha256 checksums.txt in releases. Remaining: GoReleaser/cosign/Homebrew/deb-rpm; reconsider GHCR :init step (left in place, needs a real release to verify).

title: Define interfaces for Proxmox client
description: No interfaces defined for testing/mocking. Create ProxmoxClientInterface for better testability.

title: Add environment variable support for credentials
description: Support PROX_URL, PROX_USER, PROX_PASSWORD environment variables as alternative to config file for CI/CD scenarios.

title: Make storage configurable instead of hardcoded
description: pkg/container/create.go:55 hardcodes 'local-lvm' storage. Make configurable via flag or config.

title: Add --wait flag for async operations
description: Some commands return immediately with task ID. Add --wait flag to block until operation completes and show duration.

title: Add support for VM/CT tags filtering
description: Add ability to list/filter VMs and containers by Proxmox tags: 'prox vm list --tag production'.

title: Add version command with build info
description: Add 'prox version' command showing version, git commit, build date, and Go version. Use ldflags for build-time injection.

title: Add prox logs command
description: Add ability to view Proxmox task logs from CLI. Support UPID format and --follow flag for streaming logs.

title: Implement exponential backoff for task polling
description: waitForTask implementations use fixed polling intervals. Implement exponential backoff starting at 500ms, max 5s for more efficient polling.

title: Pre-compile regex patterns for validation
description: pkg/client/validation.go:31 compiles regex on every validation call. Compile once at package level for better performance.

title: Use filepath.Join for cross-platform path construction
description: pkg/config/config.go uses string concatenation for paths. Replace with filepath.Join() for cross-platform compatibility.

title: Standardize naming conventions for VM functions
description: Mixed naming: GetVm/ShutdownVm should be GetVM/ShutdownVM per Go acronym conventions. Standardize StopVM vs ShutdownVm terminology.

title: Implement context propagation throughout codebase
description: Functions create their own context.Background() instead of accepting context parameter. Pass context from CLI commands down through stack for proper cancellation support.

title: Add progress indicators for long operations
description: Long operations (clone, migrate) show no progress. Add progress bar or spinner for better UX during lengthy operations.

title: Add configuration profiles support
description: Support multiple config profiles for different environments (homelab, production, etc). Allow switching with 'prox config use' or --profile flag.

title: Bulk operations by tag (e.g. vm start --tag web)
description: Review feature idea #8. Confirm prompt listing targets. Additive.
close_reason: --tag on vm start/shutdown and ct start/stop; lists targets, confirms (-y to skip), continues past failures and exits 1 if any failed. Delete by tag intentionally not added.

title: Template download: ct templates --available / pull
description: Review feature idea #9. Use /nodes/{n}/aplinfo. Additive.
